evals.name: api-contract
evals.prompt: Review TypeScript comments on parseComponentStory and writeComponentCatalog. Provide improved TSDoc for both, based only on implementation and tests, including failure cases and defaults. Keep runtime behavior unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Replacement comments with accurate parameter names, summary and tag extraction, catalog defaults, source-owned failures, and verification limits.
assertions: Documents all declaration parameters with their exact names.
Explains catalog title and tsconfig defaults.
Describes parse failures and rejection before catalog writes.
Preserves current custom feature behavior and explains rendering limits.

evals.name: custom-story
evals.prompt: Document a Badge story with summary, a warning about relying on color alone, an acknowledgement to the design team at https://example.com/team, anatomy and a fenced TSX example. Explain which comments Sourcebook consumes and how to verify generated output. Do not invent other behavior.
evals.expected_output: A hypothetical story comment using configured warning and acknowledgement blocks, anatomy, a fenced TSX example, and accurate source-to-HTML verification.
assertions: Uses a warning block and repeats the color-alone guidance.
Keeps the supplied acknowledgement URL in a configured credit block.
Includes a summary, anatomy, and fenced TSX example above the story export.
Explains the parse, generate, compile sequence and checks rendered warning and credit.
Distinguishes a hypothetical Badge API from verified component behavior.
